set.body:
A named rule (e.g. uncontested-assertion/v1) promotes Speech content to NarratedWorld as Inferred,
citing its premises, only when: the speaker's context is not marked deceptive, belief,
hypothetical or dream; no evidence contradicts it; and the referent link to the depicted person
is licensed (S3). Inferred stays distinct from Observed and Asserted, so analyses can include or
exclude it. The target is what the narrative establishes, not medical certainty.

Acceptance: S1 pairs pass (uncontested assertion promoted; quoted belief, lie or dream not);
removing the contradiction check fails a named test.
set.title: [evidence-binding S4] Typed defeasible promotion of speech assertions into NarratedWorld
